summary: Covers various fee reports available, including daily collection, combined collection, and due fee reports, along with filtering options and column customization.
steps: Select the desired report type (e.g., 'Daily Fee Report', 'Combined Daily Collection', 'Due Fee').
Apply filters as needed (e.g., class, stream, batch, date range, 'Show student with zero dues', 'Awake status').
Customize visible columns (e.g., class, batch, registration number) to tailor the report view.
Export the report to Excel or print it.
business_rules: **'Show student with zero dues: No'**: Displays only students with pending dues.
**'Awake status: False'**: Displays only students who have not paid any fees for the current session (defaulted students).
Filters are available in every report section for granular data analysis.
important_notes: There is currently no amount-wise filter for fee reports (e.g., 'show students who paid exactly 10,000'). This is identified as a potential future enhancement.
The 'Awake status' filter is crucial for identifying students who have not made any payments for a particular session.
